name: Medical
description: Ensure health and safety of saints at all times — before, during, and after service.

sop.label: Response
sop.text: Dispatch to a saint in need, or a saint can approach the medical team directly. Team facilitates until paramedics are called if needed.

sop.label: Coverage
sop.text: This is a 24/7 auxiliary — active and vigilant whenever anyone is at the church. Multiple stations, including one by the security booth, plus designated spaces during meetings.

sop.label: Scheduling
sop.text: Sis. Britney James and Sis. Kenda Nickerson.

sop.label: Onboarding
sop.text: Sis. Britney James. Team members are required to have health-professional experience.

goals: Create a workflow for major emergencies that involve the medical team
volunteerRecruitment: We don't actively recruit. For meetings we receive the names of those who sign up.
notes: Confirmed: Sis. Britney James leads Medical, with Sis. Kenda Nickerson as assistant. Additional needs raised in the auxiliary assessment: a dedicated space for the medical team, and clearer information-sharing between teams (security, ushers, medical, response team) when a major incident occurs. Refer to Sis. Kenda Nickerson for the supply/inventory list.

name: Servers

sop.label: Duties
sop.text: Setup to make sure tables are out, food warmers are actively engaged (during lunch/dinner events).

notes: Managed by Sis. Debra Nelson, who builds a team in advance so everyone knows their role/location.

name: Multipurpose

sop.label: Pre-Service
sop.text: Team activates before meetings and on a monthly-to-quarterly basis, meeting independently to maintain and clean the room (mopping, sweeping, sanitizing floors and tables).

sop.label: During Service
sop.text: No active role unless the room is being used for something specific.

sop.label: Post-Service
sop.text: Team is dispatched to clean up after service. For events, funerals, or major meetings, a team cleans the room both before and after.

sop.label: Safety
sop.text: Lean on the medical and security teams.

supplies: Storage for cleaning equipment and supplies (utility closet at the back of the building)
goals: Support the Saints by maintaining and keeping the multipurpose room clean
strengths: Team is flexible and never complains
events: No standing events — leader touches base with the team on an as-needed basis.
volunteerRecruitment: Face to face most of the time, or by phone.
notes: Never use kitchen supplies for the multipurpose room — cross-contamination is a major concern.

name: Choir
description: The music ministry exists to lead the congregation in worship through song, creating an atmosphere where people can encounter God more deeply. It also nurtures spiritual growth by using music to teach, inspire, and unite the church community in praise and worship.

sop.label: Setup
sop.text: Before service starts, the Audio/Visual Production team needs to have their setup complete for sound and lyrics. Choir/Band needs to be in place prior to the worship service starting.

sop.label: During Service
sop.text: The choir and band make themselves available to accompany the service as needed. They respond to the flow of service or special requests.

sop.label: Breakdown
sop.text: The choir stand is left in clean condition, trash in the trash can, fans/tambourines put away neatly. The organ and piano must be covered when not in use.

sop.label: Emergency & Safety
sop.text: Health: Sis. Britney James and Sis. Sarena Martin are available to assist. Security concern: Bro. Kevin Reed or Bro. Ello Castille. Weather: follow church guidance.

sop.label: Scheduling
sop.text: Choir members and band serve the ministry unless they're needed in another auxiliary — several also serve in Cleaning, Ushers, or Medical. The ministry operates regardless of how many are present.

sop.label: Onboarding
sop.text: Aspirants let the choir director know they'd like to join the choir or band, then attend rehearsals prior to joining the ministry.

sop.label: Special Circumstances
sop.text: The only service where the format changes is youth services.

supplies: Throat lozenges (choir members provide as needed)
Instrument maintenance — piano under warranty, organ has a technician on call, drum tuning/sticks funded by the church
notes: The ministry depends on the Audio, Visual Production, and Communications teams. Roles & Responsibilities within the team not yet documented.

name: Audio
description: Also referred to as "Sound" in the auxiliary assessment.

sop.label: Pre-Service
sop.text: Team arrives 10 minutes early to turn off projectors and turn on cameras. Setup instructions are laminated to the back of the AV desk near the first computer.

sop.label: Scheduling
sop.text: Sis. Nyree Reed builds the schedule a month in advance.

sop.label: During/Post-Service
sop.text: Sound equipment is set up and, afterward, everything is recharged and reset for the next service.

sop.label: Onboarding
sop.text: Handled by the team.

goals: Everyone operating the sound board the same way
strengths: Communication, willingness to work, and everyone being teachable
improvements: Getting the sound to a place where livestream sound is better
events: Works every service; no formal sound trainings yet.
volunteerRecruitment: Leader speaks with the individual they'd like to recruit, then talks to Bro. Devlon.
notes: Additional need raised: better communication with leadership, and a better way to handle livestream text questions or sound-quality issues during service. Described in the SOP transcript as a combined "Production (Audio/Visual)" team — this content applies to both Audio and Visual Production.

name: Visual Production

sop.label: Pre-Service
sop.text: Team arrives 10 minutes early to turn off projectors and turn on cameras. Setup instructions are laminated to the back of the AV desk near the first computer.

sop.label: Scheduling
sop.text: Sis. Nyree Reed builds the schedule a month in advance.

sop.label: During/Post-Service
sop.text: Sound equipment is set up and, afterward, everything is recharged and reset for the next service.

sop.label: Onboarding
sop.text: Handled by the team.

notes: Described in the SOP transcript as a combined "Production (Audio/Visual)" team — this content applies to both Audio and Visual Production.

name: Ushers
description: Covers both youth and adult ushers.

sop.label: Pre-Service Setup
sop.text: Arrive 15–20 minutes before service to get in position. Ensure gloves, sanitizer, envelopes, and fans are stocked in the sanctuary. Tissues available for saints who need them. Open doors.

sop.label: During Service
sop.text: Handle basic needs as they arise.

sop.label: Post-Service
sop.text: Minimal — no significant breakdown tasks.

sop.label: Safety
sop.text: Lean on security/medical for any incidents.

sop.label: Onboarding
sop.text: New ushers selected by Sis. Esther Smith and leadership based on fit.

goals: Having a spiritual ear while assisting God's people
strengths: Being visual and aware of surroundings

name: Kitchen
description: Handles cooking/food service for all church events (meetings, youth events, witnessing events, etc.). When outside catering is used, someone from the kitchen team still monitors the space.

sop.label: Pre-Service
sop.text: The entire kitchen team arrives ahead of time to prep meals and ingredients. Coordinates with Bro. Kyron Washington and Sis. Tanya Jones on what's needed; works with Sis. Sherri Turner on budget/ordering.

sop.label: During Service
sop.text: Not required unless meals are being prepared for a meeting (lunch/dinner around meetings or large events).

sop.label: Post-Service Cleanup
sop.text: Bro. Anthony Chapman, Bro. Marlin Allen, and Bro. Javier lead cleanup — recruiting team members to wash dishes, put away plates/ingredients, and mop the floor.

sop.label: Safety
sop.text: Report issues to the ministry, medical team, or security team.

sop.label: Scheduling
sop.text: Sis. Tanya Jones and Bro. Kyron Washington.

sop.label: Onboarding
sop.text: Entire kitchen staff helps train new members on policies and operations.

name: Transportation
description: Move saints between locations during meetings — parking lot to church, using golf carts or a van. During large events, coordinates with finance leads on how many carts are needed based on meeting size.

sop.label: Airport Runs
sop.text: Team ready 2–4 hours before service for pickups; drop-offs 1–2 hours after service ends.

sop.label: During Service
sop.text: Minimal, except if a saint needs to catch a flight mid-service.

sop.label: Duties
sop.text: Drop saints at cars via golf cart/van, transport to the Marriott (across the street), and airport drop-offs.

sop.label: Safety
sop.text: Lean on medical team for emergencies.

sop.label: Onboarding
sop.text: Handled by Bro. Jim Smith.

name: Parking Lot
description: Ensure saints reach the facility safely — direct traffic, park cars.

sop.label: Service Breakdown
sop.text: Drop-off/pick-up facilitation on arrival and departure; manage traffic flow as people leave.

sop.label: Safety
sop.text: Lean on medical team for health emergencies.

sop.label: Scheduling
sop.text: Bro. James Williams, who trains alongside the parking lot staff and coordinates with the transportation team.

name: Cleaning

sop.label: Structure
sop.text: There are 5 cleaning teams, each handling a designated week for cleaning the church.

sop.label: Duties
sop.text: Assigned team cleans on Fridays and Sundays — both after service and between services.

sop.label: Training
sop.text: Teams train and onboard new members.

sop.label: Key Holders
sop.text: Bro. James Williams, Bro. Kyron Washington, Bro. Kevin Reed, Bro. Dennis Bryant, Bro. LaDaryon.

supplies: Sanitization supplies (stocked in the facility cabinet at the front of the church)
notes: Anyone who notices an issue should notify someone within the church or a team lead.

name: Youth Work

sop.label: Pre-Event
sop.text: Team arrives 1–2 hours ahead to set up.

sop.label: During Service
sop.text: No active role.

sop.label: Post-Service
sop.text: Helps clean up after youth events.

sop.label: Leadership
sop.text: Bro. Marlin Allen and Bro. Anthony Chapman (youth council) recruit new members and plan/facilitate events — including Bible class, Youth Sundays, and youth retreats.

goals: Experience an outpouring of the Holy Ghost on our youth and adults
Develop, improve, and build upon our Sunday morning Bible class
Strengthen the relationship amongst the youth of our assembly and others
strengths: Strong individual relationships with the kids
Sunday Morning Bible class teachers who love the word of God and the children
Kids enjoy fellowship with each other when traveling to other churches or at events
improvements: Internal communication and communication with the church needs development
Scheduling conflicts with other auxiliaries limit when the team can meet
Need more fellowship events for kids and the community
Need an avenue for kids to stay connected throughout the week
Need more eyes on children to make sure struggling kids aren't falling through the cracks
events: Youth Council Meeting every first Sunday of the month; Youth Retreat; South regional youth meeting; West Coast regional youth meeting; Shut-ins; Fun Day; Tea Party; Sunday morning Bible class.
volunteerRecruitment: In progress: a landing page on the TLG Mesquite website with a "Come be a part / Come serve" button. Volunteers complete a questionnaire and background check, then are vetted for available serving areas.
notes: Leadership is open to suggestions and improvements to process.

name: Finance
description: Ensure the church operates efficiently with the resources it's given.

sop.label: Lead
sop.text: Sis. Sherri Turner, with assistants standing by for the offering pre-service.

sop.label: Duties
sop.text: Handle needs as they arise, including planning and budgeting for all finance-related matters.

sop.label: Onboarding/Training
sop.text: Sis. Sherri Turner.

name: Maintenance
description: Ensure the church facility operates properly — HVAC, electrical, groundskeeping, and general commercial building maintenance.

sop.label: Lead
sop.text: Bro. Dennis Bryant. Issues are reported to him, and he assigns team members/contractors as needed, coordinating with the finance office.

sop.label: During Service
sop.text: Bro. Dennis Bryant handles any maintenance needs that arise.

name: Communications
description: Keep the church up to date on upcoming events and ensure members have the info they need to attend.

sop.label: Lead
sop.text: Sis. Sonya Clark.

sop.label: Method
sop.text: Announcements made after every service, posted in a slideshow, or sent via text.

name: Women's Work
description: Develop spirituality among the women of the church. Not part of the original contact roster — added from the auxiliary assessment survey. Please confirm leadership contact details.

sop.label: Events
sop.text: Handled by Sis. Kenda Nickerson; scheduling for who helps with events is managed by the auxiliary leader.

goals: Engage women to attend prayer at church
Work with younger women to learn how to facilitate settings
Unity among the sisters — getting to know each other
strengths: Allowing settings to be spirit led
improvements: Engaging sisters who don't attend or come late
volunteerRecruitment: Text, announcements, and one-on-one conversations depending on the need.
notes: Designated day for Women's Work group text updates is Thursdays; frequency otherwise depends on the event.
